summary: Iter 27 EDA backend testing complete. All 4 phases verified: bus infrastructure (Redis Streams nt:events + group nt:workers with 2 consumers + 9 registered handlers + unique idx on processed_events.event_id), publish/consume + idempotency + retry-to-DLQ, real-HTTP publishers (purchase.created via POST /api/admin/supplier/purchases verified end-to-end through dual-write into processed_events), and observability endpoints (/api/admin/event-bus/{stats,processed,dlq,movements,replay}). Regression: all 42 tests from iter20-26 still pass.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with {ok:false, error:'event not found'} for missing event_id instead of 404. Functional but inconsistent with REST norms; client/UI must check body.ok.
DeprecationWarning: redis.asyncio Redis.close() — should use aclose(). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Switch replay endpoint to 404 when event_id not found, or document the 200+ok:false contract.
(Optional cleanup) Replace redis_async.close() with aclose() in test_iter27_eda.py to silence deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Dual-write pattern correctly implemented: sync routes do their work first, then publish events inside try/except so publish failures never break HTTP flow (verified in platform_finance_routes.py L204-220).
Event schema (models/events.py) correctly serialises all wire fields as strings (Redis Streams requirement) and round-trips cleanly.
Idempotency via unique index on processed_events.event_id is enforced at the DB layer — duplicate-publish test confirms second event is silently ACK'd.

Consumer registers all 9 handlers as per spec (purchase.created, purchase.codes_uploaded, sale.completed, sale.refunded, ecom_order.confirmed, ecom_order.cancelled, tenant.subscription.expired, tenant.subscription.renewed, test.ping).
ecom_order.confirmed deducts stock atomically and sets _eda_stock_deducted flag — verified idempotent on double-publish (stock deducted exactly once).

rca of the issue: No bugs found. All assertions hold against the live system.
